operations.name: Timothy Justen French

expected.charges: Intentionally damaging a protected computer without authorization, 18 U.S.C. 1030(a)(5)(A)
expected.sentence: Forty-five months in federal prison, imposed November 1, 2016. French later spent time in a halfway house, was returned to custody, and was released on January 14, 2019. The exact beginning and intermediate custody dates are not established.

operations.source: Primary November 1, 2016 sentencing report: https://www.justice.gov/usao-ndil/pr/member-computer-hacking-group-nullcrew-sentenced-nearly-four-years-launching-cyber . Individual sentencing judge and prosecutor explicitly named. No admission date inferred from sentencing.

operations.name: Ellen Grusse

expected.charges: Civil contempt for refusing grand-jury testimony — 28 U.S.C. §1826
expected.sentence: February 19 contempt order; execution stayed. Actual confinement March 5 to April 1, 1975. This was coercive civil custody, not a criminal conviction.

operations.source: Primary February 27, 1975 opinion, United States v. Grusse, 515 F.2d 157: https://www.neochart.com/catalog/cases/f2d/volume_515/0157_01/index.html . Names judge of February 19 contempt order. Applies only to first civil-contempt case; no criminal conviction asserted.
